Banner.Title: Cookie Management
Banner.Description: Our site uses two types of cookies, both optional, and no advertising or tracking cookies:

CookieTypes.Essential: • A comfort cookie, to speed up your browsing (stay logged in, remember your preferences and what you type into tools)
CookieTypes.Session: • A session cookie, necessary to log into your account

Banner.NoTracking: We respect your privacy: no advertising or tracking cookies are used.

Comfort.Title: Comfort Cookie
Comfort.Description: This cookie remembers your preferences (theme, language) and some of the data you type into tools (for example yesterday's Watch list), so you don't have to re-enter everything on each visit. It also lets you stay logged in longer if you activated the 'Stay logged in' option. Nothing is sent to a third party, nothing is used for advertising tracking — without this cookie, the site remains usable, just without memory from one visit to the next.
Comfort.Label: Comfort cookie

Session.Title: Session Cookie
Session.Description: This cookie contains a token. With this token, your current session can be continued while using the site. This cookie is valid for 2 hours after creation and is renewed each time you change pages on this site.
Session.Label: Session cookie

Modal.Title: Manage Cookie Preferences
Modal.Description: We use two types of cookies to offer you the best possible experience:

Cookies.SessionWarning: Warning: Without session cookies, you will not be able to log into your account.
